# GeeksforGeeks

> > A comprehensive computer science learning portal covering DSA, programming languages (Java, C++, Python, JavaScript), interview preparation, and software development tutorials.

GeeksforGeeks is one of the largest educational platforms for computer science students and professionals, offering tutorials, practice problems, courses, and interview preparation resources across data structures, algorithms, programming languages, web development, machine learning, and system design.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Java Programming
- C++ Programming
- Python Programming
- JavaScript
- Interview Preparation
- System Design
- Web Development
- Machine Learning
- Linux
- C Programming
- Programming Tutorials
- Coding Practice
- Computer Science Courses

## Main Portal

- [GeeksforGeeks | Your All-in-One Learning Portal](https://gdevtest.geeksforgeeks.org/): Homepage for GeeksforGeeks learning portal covering DSA, Java, C++, and more
